notes.title: Interface Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I continue to work on improving the user experience. However, before adding new pop-up tips, I needed to deal with bugs in the current interface. This is what today's patch was dedicated to. Here's what has been fixed:

When switching window mode, containers now scale correctly.

The unit characteristics container is now used both in battle and in the store.

The unit characteristics container is displayed in battle next to the cursor, not in the center of the screen as before.

When hovering over an opponent, the cells that he can attack no longer include cells with obstacles.

The "Retreat" button can no longer be pressed during the transition between rounds, so as not to disrupt animations in the battle scene.

The victory congratulation after ten victories has been returned.

Fixed the hearts animation when transitioning to play-offs.

The placeholders for the player's name, opponent's name, and Doppelganger are now translated to the interface language.

The “Community” button now leads to the page corresponding to the selected interface language.

Fixed the attack sound of PRIEST.

Fixed the gold display on the battle results screen when the player is defeated in the first battle.

notes.title: Major Changes and New Platform
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋


This update is a bit delayed because I was preparing a version for itch.io. Now you can play the demo Knight's Errand right in your browser or on your phone. I hope this attracts more players, and the variety of opponents will become even greater. In addition, we have made many changes to the game and fixed a lot of bugs.
[hr][/hr]

Gameplay ⚔️


💰 Updated Economy: Now the gold for lost squads and for defeated enemies depends on the course of the battle. This makes early defeats less painful, and late ones more tense, as compensation for losses decreases, and the reward for victory grows.

📈 Reward for Defeats: If the player suffers a series of defeats, the reward for defeated enemies increases slightly for them to avoid a "death spiral". I'm not sure yet how balanced this is, so the mechanic may change in the future.

🪙 Store Scaling: The number of units available for purchase now grows with the number of battles. This allows creating armies from cheap creatures even in late stages, adding variety to tactics and making the store fairer.

🔄 Full Cost Refund: When disbanding a squad in the store, its full cost is now returned.

🏆 Shared Leaderboard: Play-off now uses a single leaderboard for all platforms — Steam and Itch.io. Opponent armies are also stored in a common repository.

📊 Access to Rating: Now the game has a full leaderboard, not just the player's personal rank.

🤖 Offline Mode: Even without an internet connection, battles continue, but against a doppelganger army.
[hr][/hr]

Screen Resolution 🖥️


📐 Scale Change: The game's resolution has been changed from 480x270 to 630x460. On large monitors, the game now looks much better, and it gives me more flexibility to work with the interface. On mobile devices, the game seems a bit small now, but I plan to add mode switching in the future.
[hr][/hr]

Interface ⚙️


🎮 New Main Menu: The game now has a main menu with buttons for feedback and adding to the wishlist.

⛓️ Animated Menus: All main menus are now hung on chains and appear and disappear effectively. I hope fans of old strategies will like this.

💨 Separate Initiative: The initiative indicator is now displayed separately from the number of units, allowing for a quicker assessment of the battlefield situation.

➡️ Disappearing Indicator: After a squad's turn, its initiative disappears to not take up space on the screen.

💡 Highlighting Information: Panels with the number of units and initiative now come to the foreground when hovering over a unit, allowing quick assessment of its stats without obscuring the rest of the screen.

✨ Button Highlighting: In the store, when the player has no squads in the army, not only units are highlighted, but also buttons for their purchase. This will help newcomers better understand the interface.

🖱️ Improved Controls: Combinations Shift+LMB, Ctrl+LMB and double-click now deselect the original squad after splitting it. From a UI/UX perspective, this is more logical.

🪙 Slider Limitation: The unit quantity slider in the store now moves only up to the maximum available for purchase, making the process more convenient if gold is insufficient.
[hr][/hr]

Bugs 🐞


✅ Correct Damage: Potential damage for blocked ranged units is now calculated correctly.

🗑️ Disappeared Copies: Dragging a squad in the store no longer leaves a copy with 0 units.

🎶 Looped Sounds: All background sound effects are now looped and do not stop after the first playback.

notes.title: Huge Battle UI Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Pleased to present a demo update that brings significant improvements to the gameplay! The main changes involve the combat interface; additionally, there are refinements to the animation system, fund reimbursement, and AI behavior, along with several important bug fixes.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/cf782e7b8cd5246cc538e48537fceafd2e2f4bf5.gif"]
Combat Interface Changes ⚔️
The combat interface is now significantly more informative and user-friendly:

🗺️ Movement Zone Display:

When hovering over an enemy unit, its movement zone now appears.

🌐 Pressing the ALT key shows the movement zones of all enemies, which helps better assess threats and plan actions.

🎯 Damage Prediction: Now, the potential damage to an enemy can be predicted in advance, allowing for more informed tactical decisions.

💀 Attack Result: After an attack, the amount of damage dealt and units destroyed are displayed above the target.

❤️ Top Unit Health: The current health indicator for the top unit in a stack has been added for a better understanding of the army's current state.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/5c58b6bb6501e85e5215631f742a0449b53f072d.png"]

⏳ Initiative Scale Position: To the right of the unit count in a stack, its position on the initiative scale is now displayed, simplifying turn planning.

🖱️ Detailed Unit Characteristics: In combat, a right-click on a unit now shows all its characteristics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/c83000a28977c708697958eae4a54c97e768909e.gif"]

💡 Unit Selection Hint: A hint about selecting a unit has been added when multiple units have the same initiative.

🔄 Counterattack Indication: The display of counterattack availability has been reworked:

🌟 If a unit has a counterattack, the number of units in the stack is displayed in gold.

⚪ If it has already used its counterattack, the number is displayed in white, allowing for instant assessment of the unit's readiness to retaliate.
[hr][/hr]

Other Changes


🎬 Animation System:

The animation system has been completely reworked. While it might not be immediately noticeable, transitions between animations should be smoother.

🔊 This change forms the foundation for future improvements and will allow for more flexible animation customization and synchronization with sounds, which will make the game feel more alive and dynamic in the future.

💰 Fund Reimbursement System:

The full fund reimbursement system, regardless of the number of victories, has been reinstated. This seems to be the fairest approach for players at the moment.

🧹 Consequently, a wipe of the army pool has been performed.
[hr][/hr]

AI Improvements 🤖


AI behavior has been slightly improved:

🏹 Ranged Unit Targeting: Ranged units controlled by AI now consider the threat posed by the player's unit when determining targets for attack.

🛡️ Melee Unit Defense: AI now correctly defends its melee units, making its tactics more coherent.
[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes 🐞


Several bugs have been fixed:

💎 Incorrect Rarity Display: Fixed an issue with the incorrect display of unlocked unit rarity.

🔍 Cursor Scale: The cursor scale bug has been addressed.
[hr][/hr]
Hope these changes make your gaming experience even more enjoyable! I continue to work on improving the game and welcome your feedback! Try the new patch, share your thoughts on the demo in the comments, and add the full version of the game to your wishlists!
